body:
Both fixes done. Build clean (exit 0, 40 pages).

FIX 1 (FOUC): `src/layouts/Layout.astro:47` — `<html lang="en">` → `<html lang="en" style="background-color:#0a0a0a">`. Inline bg covers view-transition swap gap + slow first load.

FIX 2 (cert images, src/pages/cv/index.astro certifications section):
1. `width="1650" height="1275"` added — CLS fixed
2. `decoding="async"` added
3. `alt=""` — screen reader no longer reads title twice
4. `max-w-md` removed, kept `w-full` — image now fills card width with rounded-lg border border-border
5. Link: `transition-colors hover:underline` — deviation from spec: spec said `hover:text-accent` but link is already `text-accent`, so color change is a no-op = zero hover feedback. Kept underline (existing visible hover state) + added transition-colors per consistency intent.
6. Arrow dropped — link reads "Verify on Coursera"

Not touched: dates, JSON-LD, other content. All changes verified by re-read. Build: `pnpm build` → ✓ 40 page(s) built, Complete, no errors.
